query: insert into public.gateway_auth_sessions(oauth_session_id,user_id,source_expires_at) values($1,$2,$3) on conflict(oauth_session_id) do update set source_expires_at=excluded.source_expires_at,updated_at=now() where gateway_auth_sessions.user_id=excluded.user_id and gateway_auth_sessions.revoked_at is null returning source_expires_at
